rows.text: calls `0031B760(rcx)` with the incoming `rcx` and returns 0 when the result is null, when bit 3 of its dword `+0` is clear, when its qword `+0x698` is null or when byte `+5` of that object is non-zero; otherwise returns the inverse of bit 23 of the dword `+0`

returns 0 when `ecx - 1` is above 0x1D (unsigned); otherwise indexes a byte table after the body by `ecx - 1` and dispatches through a jump table, which (decoded from the bytes) give: `ecx` 1 to 3 returns 0x15, 4 to 6 0x16, 7 0x17, 8 0x18, 9 to 13 0x19, 14 0x1A, 15 to 17 0x1B, 18 0x1C, 19 and 20 0x1D, 30 0x1E, and 21 to 29 return 0
calls `002640C0` with the incoming registers, pops a value with `00267E10(r9)`, resolves `002650B0(002640C0 result, rdx, value)` and tail-jumps `003E92F0(002640C0 result, resolved pointer)`

tail-jumps through the eight-byte entry, indexed by the sign-extended byte `+0x3C` of `rcx`, of the code-pointer table at `00D22790`, with `rcx`, `r8` and `r9` as passed in and `rdx` overwritten with the table base

calls `002640C0` with the incoming registers and zeroes three stack floats; when `PartyFocus_GetCurrentPackedActorHandle()` is non-zero calls `Actor_GetWorldPosition(003588B0(that value), &float0, &float1, &float2)`; then resolves three pointers with `002650B0(002640C0 result, rcx, 00267E10(r9))` in turn and stores float0 through the third, float1 through the second and float2 through the first
pops a value with `00267E10(r9)`, resolves `002650B0(002640C0(), rdx, value)` and tail-jumps `002393E0(rdx, resolved pointer)`
